Entries.Title: TV5
Entries.Description: TV5 is a major Philippine television network offering a mix of local and international programming, including news, entertainment, and sports.

Entries.Title: A2Z (ABS-CBN)
Entries.Description: A2Z is a Philippine free-to-air blocktime broadcast television network based in Quezon City, with its studios located in Ortigas Center, Pasig. It serves as a flagship property of ZOE Broadcasting Network, the broadcast media arm of Jesus Is Lord Church Worldwide, in partnership with ABS-CBN Corporation as its main content provider through a blocktime agreement.

Entries.Title: Jurassic World Rebirth
Entries.Description: Five years after the events of Jurassic World Dominion, covert operations expert Zora Bennett is contracted to lead a skilled team on a top-secret mission to secure genetic material from the world's three most massive dinosaurs. When Zora's operation intersects with a civilian family whose boating expedition was capsized, they all find themselves stranded on an island where they come face-to-face with a sinister, shocking discovery that's been hidden from the world for decades.

Entries.Title: Night Carnage
Entries.Description: A blogger who is also a werewolf meets a dashing playboy with a dark secret of his own. Starring Logan Andrews and Christian Howard.

Entries.Title: The Pickup
Entries.Description: A routine cash pickup takes a wild turn when mismatched armored truck drivers Russell and Travis are ambushed by ruthless criminals led by savvy mastermind Zoe.

Entries.Title: Creation of the Gods II: Demon Force
Entries.Description: Taishi Wen Zhong led the army of Shang Dynasty including Deng Chanyu and four generals of the Mo Family to Xiqi. With the help of Kunlun immortals such as Jiang Ziya, Ji Fa led the army and civilians of Xiqi to defend their homeland.

Entries.Title: How to Train Your Dragon
Entries.Description: On the rugged isle of Berk, where Vikings and dragons have been bitter enemies for generations, Hiccup stands apart, defying centuries of tradition when he befriends Toothless, a feared Night Fury dragon. Their unlikely bond reveals the true nature of dragons, challenging the very foundations of Viking society.

Entries.Title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba — Infinity Castle
Entries.Description: As the Demon Slayer Corps members and Hashira engaged in a group strength training program, the Hashira Training, in preparation for the forthcoming battle against the demons, Muzan Kibutsuji appears at the Ubuyashiki Mansion. With the head of the Demon Corps in danger, Tanjiro and the Hashira rush to the headquarters but are plunged into a deep descent to a mysterious space by the hands of Muzan Kibutsuji.  The destination of where Tanjiro and Demon Slayer Corps have fallen is the demons' stronghold – the Infinity Castle. And so, the battleground is set as the final battle between the Demon Slayer Corps and the demons ignites.

Entries.Title: Ne Zha 2
Entries.Description: After a catastrophic event leaves their bodies destroyed, Ne Zha and Ao Bing are granted a fragile second chance at life. As tensions rise between the dragon clans and celestial forces, the two must undergo a series of perilous trials that will test their bond, challenge their identities, and decide the fate of both mortals and immortals.

Entries.Title: KPop Demon Hunters
Entries.Description: When K-pop superstars Rumi, Mira and Zoey aren't selling out stadiums, they're using their secret powers to protect their fans from supernatural threats.

Entries.Title: The Bad Guys 2
Entries.Description: The now-reformed Bad Guys are trying (very, very hard) to be good, but instead find themselves hijacked into a high-stakes, globe-trotting heist, masterminded by a new team of criminals they never saw coming: The Bad Girls.

Entries.Title: Kaiju No. 8: Mission Recon
Entries.Description: In a Kaiju-filled Japan, Kafka Hibino works in monster disposal. After reuniting with his childhood friend Mina Ashiro, a rising star in the anti-Kaiju Defense Force, he decides to pursue his abandoned dream of joining the Force, when he suddenly transforms into the powerful "Kaiju No. 8." An action-packed recap of the first season of Kaiju No. 8 and a new original episode, Hoshina's Day Off.

Entries.Title: Mercy for None
Entries.Description: After severing ties with his gang, a former gangster returns to uncover the truth behind his brother's death — embarking on a relentless path of revenge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After Nam Gi-seok's mysterious death, Nam Gi-jun emerges from seclusion on a mission to find the perpetrator — no matter the cost.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: After tracking down Gi-seok's hit, Gi-jun discovers the scheme's origin — forcing him to enforce a rule he established more than a decade ago.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Despite his father's precautions, Gu Jun-mo underestimates the threat he faces. Frustrated and desperate, he decides to handle Gi-jun himself.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Desperate to save his son, Chairman Gu digs deeper into Gi-seok's hit. After Jun-mo attacks his friends, Gi-jun goes head-to-head with Jun-mo's army.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Gi-jun quickly learns that his problems don't end with Jun-mo. A gang war breaks out after Chairman Lee suspects the real architect behind recent events.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Cha Yeong-do sets his plan in motion. As Lee Geum-son seizes power, Gi-jun faces betrayal, danger, and a race to uncover the truth behind it all.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: With all his obstacles cleared, Geum-son puts his endgame into play. Will Gi-jun succeed in stopping him, or go down trying?

Entries.Title: The Winning Try
Entries.Description: A disgraced former rugby star returns as a coach to his high school’s struggling team, where he reunites with his ex-girlfriend and helps the determined captain lead the team to redemption.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Ju Ga-ram reemerges after a doping scandal to coach the struggling rugby team at his alma mater — facing pushback from colleagues, players and his ex.

Entries.Title: A Dream Within a Dream
Entries.Description: When Song Xiaoyu is unexpectedly pulled into a scripted world as a tragic heroine fated to be discarded by the villainous male lead, she tries to escape, only to be trapped in an endless loop of fatal outcomes each time she strays from the plot. No matter how hard she resists, the story keeps pushing her toward Nan Heng, the cold and calculating lead. As she navigates this paper-thin world where every character is bound by fate, Song Xiaoyu must fight not just for her survival, but for control over her own story.

Episodes.Title: Becoming the Female Lead
Episodes.Description: During the script-reading for a period drama, Song Xiaoyu feels that it's unfair for Song Yimeng, the female lead. On the other hand, a click on the keyboard sends Song Xiaoyu into the script of Dream of Qingning.

Episodes.Title: Six Months before the Wedding
Episodes.Description: After crossing over into Song Yimeng's body, Song Xiaoyu is surprised to find out that she has arrived six months before her wedding. It seems she now has enough time to gradually change the course of the story.

Episodes.Title: Love Line
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng jumps into the water as soon as he hears Song Yimeng falling into the water. While Song Yimeng is struggling, she sees Nan Heng who looks exactly like Nan Feng. Her first reaction is to never go through the plot with him.

Episodes.Title: Stalling Tactic
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng doesn't know that Nan Heng is determined to kill her. She tries to bargain for her life with the Duan Blade Technique.

Episodes.Title: Law of Mutual Rescue
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng intends to be on good terms with Chu Guihong, who was just released from prison. She tells him how Nan Heng is going to put him on the spot in the imperial court.

Episodes.Title: Assassin
Episodes.Description: Fading River Moon is a guild hall opened in the capital by Nan Heng three years ago in secret. He has another secret identity, which is...

Episodes.Title: Playing Along
Episodes.Description: Shangguan He advises Nan Heng to use his identity as Li Shiliu to get closer to Song Yimeng and sabotage the marriage alliance between the Song and Chu families.

Episodes.Title: Two Li Shi Liu
Episodes.Description: The real and fake Li Shiliu duke it out in Fading River Moon until the real one knocks the mask off of Chu Guihong. Only then could the people see...

Episodes.Title: Everyone Has Their Own Agenda
Episodes.Description: Li Shiliu watches as Song Yimeng lets the scroll of the Plan to Kill Heng, covered in writing, slip to the ground. A flicker of tension tightens between his brows.

Episodes.Title: A Wish
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng watches Song Yimeng make a wish sincerely. He tells Song Yimeng that if she can help him get the Duan Blade Technique, no matter what her wish is, he'll help her fulfill it.

Episodes.Title: Fire in the Southern District
Episodes.Description: Concerned about the raging fire at the oil mill, Li Shiliu leads the members of Fading River Moon into the heart of the blaze to help.

Episodes.Title: Once Friends
Episodes.Description: Under the guise of his dual identity, Nan Heng joins Song Yimeng in rebuilding the southern district. In the process, he finally uncovers the reason behind her hatred toward him.

Episodes.Title: Cracking the Secret Symbol
Episodes.Description: When Nan Heng visits his mother, Noble Consort Gao, he accidentally finds clues about the Duan Blade Technique in her old belongings.

Episodes.Title: A Public Proposal
Episodes.Description: Song Yi Meng is in love with Li Shiliu. She refuses to marry Chu Gui Hong.

Episodes.Title: Expressing One's Feelings
Episodes.Description: The emperor interrogates Song Yimeng for instigating the two princes into starting a conflict. To protect Song Yimeng, Nan Heng barges into the imperial study room and bears the blame.

Episodes.Title: Immortal under the Moonlight
Episodes.Description: Li Shiliu pays a secret visit to the Song Residence at late night. As he departs, his striking figure beneath the moonlight catches Song Yiting's eye and sparks her curiosity.

Episodes.Title: Granted Marriage
Episodes.Description: To protect Chu Guihong, the emperor makes a deal with Nan Heng to cancel the marriage between the Song and the Chu families. Nan Heng and Song Yimeng feel happy about the decision but the emperor also grants a marriage between Nan Heng and Song Yimeng.

Episodes.Title: Changing Fate
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng wants to kill Nan Heng again. She has made up her mind to protect the Song family from getting wiped out by Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: Concubine
Episodes.Description: Noble Consort Gao invites a group of noble ladies and their daughters to Fanghua Hall. She says that she's going to help Nan Heng choose a concubine. In reality, she's trying to stir Song Yimeng's feelings for Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: Offense and Defense
Episodes.Description: To keep her sister from being deceived by Nan Heng, Song Yimeng resolves to take action against him.

Episodes.Title: Last Farewell
Episodes.Description: Shangguan He tells Li Shiliu everything about the blade and Song Yiting. Li Shiliu wants Shangguan He to disguise himself as Li Shiliu for one last time tomorrow and retrieve the blade.

Episodes.Title: A Do-Or-Die Plan
Episodes.Description: Zhou Xueyi continues to force Song Yiting to get married. She has had enough and decides to have a union with Li Shiliu when he comes for the sword. Nan Heng dresses up as Li Shiliu to meet her. He then realizes that Song Yiting has lit a drugged incense that causes him to be paralyzed.

Episodes.Title: Identity Revealed
Episodes.Description: The capital is trying to arrest the Night Wandering Gods. Li Shiliu goes to their hiding spot and announces their disbandment. But they think that he's trying to protect them by saving Shangguan He himself. Due to that, they aren't willing to leave.

Episodes.Title: Atone with His Life
Episodes.Description: Learning Shangguan He is going to be executed, Song Yiting asks Song Yimeng for help.

Episodes.Title: Let Go of Yourself
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng is stopped by Nan Heng as she leaves the execution ground. She refuses to listen to his explanation and instead demands that he give an answer to the Night Wandering Gods, who were still desperately defending him even on the eve of the execution.

Episodes.Title: Assassination
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng rushes over when he finds out that Song Yimeng is in danger. He fights the men in black despite his injuries.

Episodes.Title: Destiny Can Be Changed
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng hears about Gao Changying's death. Song Yude says that the rumors circulating in the Capital have pinpointed Nan Heng as the culprit. Song Yimeng insists that Nan Heng won't do something like that.

Episodes.Title: Forced to Extremes
Episodes.Description: Long and Hu are caught and interrogated by Chu Guihong, who resorts to brutal torture just to make them testify against Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: Mastermind
Episodes.Description: Chu Guihong accuses Nan Heng of ordering the assassination of Luyi. Nan Heng refutes the claim, stating that the testimony is fabricated and that the witnesses can be summoned at any time for cross-examination.

Episodes.Title: Redemption
Episodes.Description: The Gao Residence has been sealed off. His accomplices and everyone in his party are exiled to Han Bei. Nan Heng returns the Tiger Tally of the Armored Soldiers to His Majesty. His Majesty hands him the Crown Prince appointment decree. Nan Heng refuses by saying that he has sinned.

Episodes.Title: World in a Storybook
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng arranges for a proposal at Fading River Moon. However, Song Yimeng rejects him unwillingly after his confession.

Episodes.Title: The Vow
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng brings Song Yimeng to the God of Matchmaker's Temple and vows to protect her and her family. Touched by his confession, Song Yimeng agrees to marry him.

Episodes.Title: New Life
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng wakes up from his injury. The emperor orders the Eastern Palace to be built on the side of the inner palace for Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: The Scripted World
Episodes.Description: Chu Guihong returns to the capital city with King Qian Yu. While Song Yimeng is waiting for Nan Heng at Fanghua Hall, she accidentally runs into King Qian Yu who calls himself the Screenwriter.

Episodes.Title: In a Different Light
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng takes King Qian Yu to Fading River Moon to let him experience the interesting place. At the same time, she tries to convince him to respect the characters and allow them to live as they please.

Episodes.Title: Fate
Episodes.Description: King Qian Yu tells Nan Heng that according to the rule of scripted world, anyone who changes their fate will suffer backlash.

Episodes.Title: Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng rushes into King Qian Yu's residence and asks him if he is involved in the poisoning of the emperor and the framing of Nan Rui...

Episodes.Title: Infinity Loop
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng wakes up from a dream-like death scene. She realizes that she is back at the crown prince's residence. She is thrilled when she sees that Nan Heng is still alive.

Episodes.Title: Launching a Pre-emptive Strike
Episodes.Description: Chu Guihong changes his plans. He frames Nan Heng in advance for the poisoned mandarins the Emperor was having. He intrudes upon the Emperor's bedchamber to do the deed.

Episodes.Title: Turning the Tide
Episodes.Description: The group sets up an ambush in the streets to intercept the Qianyu Army. King Qian Yu shows up and persuades the Qianyu soldiers to switch sides.
